items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you have the theory book that Professor Shonini used to write?

ctx.x: They're used to... I used to know it. But I don't know none of them now.
I want to ask you... Do you... Maybe you have... Because I know if you keep saying... Do you have the theory book that Professor Shonini used to write? No, boy, I sure wish I had that.
